instructions_to_main_agent: Refactor /app/frontend/src/pages/Profile.js into a high-end, premium SaaS Profile page.
Ensure total visual parity with AccountSettings.js (rounded-2xl cards, border-stone-200, emerald-700 primary, slate-900 buttons, soft-square icon headers).
Implement Section 1: Cover banner with dark emerald gradient, subtle texture, overlapping circular avatar with user initials, full name, role badge pill, organization name, and Member since date.
Implement Section 2: Personal details section in a two-column layout (3/5 and 2/5 on desktop).
Provide inline editing for Full Name, Recovery Email, and Recovery Mobile with clear view/edit state transitions, validation, and Sonner toast notifications.
Keep Primary Email and Role read-only.
Do NOT include password or subscription sections on this page as they live in Account Settings.
Ensure all data-testid attributes listed in design_guidelines.json are applied to elements for automated testing.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: Never use generic centered layouts or simplistic default inputs.
Use 2-3x generous spacing with p-6 or p-8 inside cards to avoid text boundary collision.
Do not use transparent dropdown or card backgrounds.
Always specify explicit text color on hover states.
Ensure mobile 390px responsiveness and testing attribute completeness.
